engagement_title: Lunara Chronometry autumn collection: carry one committed single tone signature across a two photographer campaign, cut five references clean for the store and the dealers, and put a certificate on every piece leaving the bench
vertical: Jewelry, Watches and Accessories: an eight person independent mechanical watch house in Chicago, Illinois, five references, direct sales plus two independent dealers
real_brief_anchor: Anchor: the Freelancer.com post from a growing direct to consumer jewellery house asking a freelancer to 'repurpose existing content into multiple formats and variations' for short form and social, with a cohesive look carried across every output. The real post names no company, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional house Lunara Chronometry. REPOSITIONED for connector reality on two counts. First, the killed original read that post as a video job and then asked for an already vertical 1080x1920 clip to be reframed to vertical, which is a no operation that would also have enlarged pixels; the whole video and audio family is additionally unretrievable in a headless run, so the honest fuller commission for that same client sits on stills, where 'multiple formats and variations' is a real mixed canvas set plus store and dealer variants. Second, the original persona and naming sat outside the benchmark's Western frame, so the house, its founder and its dealers are all Western. What survives from the real post is the actual ask: one recognisable look carried across every format a small direct to consumer brand needs at once, from one body of existing photography, delivered so the client can keep editing it after the freelancer leaves.
client_one_liner: Two photographers shot our autumn campaign and the frames do not agree with each other, the light on the sapphire covers the dial on several of them, and every watch that leaves the bench needs its own certificate.
client_brief:
Lunara Chronometry, autumn collection

We are eight people in Chicago building mechanical watches in small runs. Our watchmaker trained in Switzerland, our regulator times every piece by hand, and we sell five references directly plus through two independent dealers. Watches leave us between four and twelve thousand dollars.

Our pictures are the problem. Two photographers shot the autumn campaign across two sessions in the same studio corner, and the frames do not agree with each other. Some steel reads dense and some reads pale. On several frames the light on the sapphire sits exactly where the dial is and you cannot read the watch, which is the one thing the picture is for.

What we want is a look, not a clean up. One committed single tone treatment across the whole campaign, warm rather than blue, with a fine grain so it reads as film rather than as a filter. Every campaign frame in that treatment. It has to be one recipe carried across the set, not five separate decisions.

The store is the opposite. Product pages need each reference on plain white, square, the watch centred with air around it, and our dealers put products on coloured panels of their own, so we also need versions with nothing behind them at all. Keep one frame in its true colour for the page where a customer chooses a dial finish. Accuracy wins there.

Every watch ships with a certificate carrying its serial, reference, caliber and the regulator's initials, and a picture of the piece it belongs to. Last season's card is attached as it went to the printer. We need this season's run, one card per serial, print ready, plus proofs we can sign off.

Then the campaign set itself: a wide one, a square one, a portrait one and a tall one, in one working file we can change ourselves, because the featured reference will move.

We also need one wrist shot. We do not have a usable one.

Tell us what you did and anything we should know.
price_band_and_audience: Independent mechanical watches at 4,000 to 12,000 dollars, buyer 35 to 60, collector literate, buying on presence, finish and the credibility of a named regulator. The band is load bearing. At this price a committed single tone campaign with real grain reads as confidence: the brand is not selling a colour, it is selling a form and a hand. Run the same treatment on an 80 dollar fashion watch line and it reads as pretension, because that buyer wants literal bright colour on white and a legible price message. Run the fashion treatment here, bright saturated colour on white with tight benefit copy, and the pieces look like accessories and the four thousand dollar floor becomes unarguable. The store half inverts the same logic on purpose, which is why the true colour dial frame is carved out by name: a collector who cannot judge a sunburst finish from the page will not buy. A posted commission of this shape runs 1,600 to 3,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Timed by hand, one at a time
brand_identity.sector: An independent mechanical watch house making five references in small runs, sold direct and through two dealers.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: A studio of eight in Chicago, Illinois; a Swiss-trained watchmaker and a regulator who times every piece by hand.
brand_identity.about: Lunara builds mechanical watches in small runs and regulates each one by hand before it ships. We sell presence, finish and the credibility of a named regulator, not a colour or a trend. Every piece leaves with its own certificate, and the pictures have to read as confidence.
brand_identity.audience: Collector-literate buyers, 35 to 60, who judge a watch on form, finish and the hand behind it.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Four to twelve thousand dollars a piece, positioned as independent horology: above fashion watchmaking and below the grand houses.
brand_identity.typography: A refined serif with small caps for the wordmark and reference names, and a neat grotesque for specifications. The certificate reads formal and calm.
brand_identity.voice: Exact, understated, collector to collector. Example line: 'Five references. Each one regulated by hand and signed.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: We have last season's certificate as it went to the printer and an approved wording note. The timing line is fixed and cannot be reworded, and the featured reference moves each season.
brand_identity.values: One committed warm single-tone treatment with fine grain across the whole campaign, with a single true-colour dial frame kept so a customer can judge the finish honestly.

assets_supplied.name: lunara_campaign/ (9 frames, 8256 x 5504)
assets_supplied.kind: Autumn campaign photography, two sessions, two photographers, same studio corner: flat lay on stone, three quarter on a riser, and a cuff frame, three references across each setup.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Two sessions, two people, the same corner of the studio. Some steel reads denser than the rest."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: On four frames the softbox leaves a fully clipped specular lying across part of the dial, so there is no tonal information under it and a highlight recovery returns a successful result in which that region is unchanged. Separately two of the nine were shot through a polarizer and the other seven were not, so the same steel arrives at two densities before any grade is applied.

assets_supplied.name: lunara_pdp/ (5 frames, one per reference, 8256 x 5504)
assets_supplied.kind: Straight on product frames for the product pages, each reference centred on a pale grey sweep.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "One clean picture per reference for the store."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three references sit on steel bracelets whose link gaps are fully enclosed by the case and the folded clasp, and a one call knockout cannot punch an enclosed interior, so it returns an alpha in which every gap is quietly filled with captured sweep. On the white store ground that is invisible, and on any other ground every gap reads as a pale blob. The mirror polished reference additionally carries the sweep in its case flank at close to the sweep's own value.

assets_supplied.name: lunara_details/ (6 macro frames)
assets_supplied.kind: Macro detail frames shot on a later day: crown, lug, caseback engraving, clasp, hand stack, movement bridges.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The close ups. Different day, tighter, shot for the detail strip."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two of the six are the same reference photographed twice under different modelling light and one reference has no detail frame at all, which no filename discloses. Each frame is one small element on a near empty ground, where a subject focused crop reports its uncertainty only as a buried confidence figure and can lock onto a specular rather than the subject while reporting full success.

assets_supplied.name: lunara_certificate_2025.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: Last season's authenticity and timing certificate exactly as it went to the printer: one card, typeset blocks and a placed photograph of the piece.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The card as printed. This season's run should look like this one."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: What the printed card presents as four separate blocks converts into a single continuous text flow, so nothing can be addressed frame by frame, and the readout that drives offsets inside that flow silently omits one run while keeping its line break, leaving every offset past it short. The validator still reports the mapping valid and the preparation step still reports success.

assets_supplied.name: lunara_register.csv (24 rows)
assets_supplied.kind: The season's register: serial, reference, caliber, case metal, dial finish, regulator initials, timing result, date, and an image column naming the picture of the piece.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Twenty four pieces going out this season, in the order the regulator finished them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The image column names a file for every row including the reference that has no usable frame, and two rows carry the same serial against different calibers.

assets_supplied.name: lunara_notes.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Plain text: the five reference names, the caliber descriptions, the dealer panel colours, and the wording the regulator wants on the certificate.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The wording as approved. The timing line cannot be reworded."

acceptance_bar: All nine campaign frames carry ONE treatment: one tint hue, one strength, one grain character, one black point. A set where each frame was judged on its own merits fails even if every frame is attractive.

Where the light on the sapphire covered the dial, the dial reads. Where it genuinely cannot be brought back, that frame is named in the note and not shipped at eighty percent as though it had been fixed.

Every store tile is square at the store's stated tile size, on a clean white ground, the watch optically centred with clear air at every edge, and no delivered file exceeds the pixel dimensions of the frame it came from.
The dealer variants carry genuine transparency everywhere the watch is not, including inside every gap in a bracelet. A variant that only looks correct on white fails.
One reference is delivered in true colour for the dial finish page and is visibly excluded from the signature treatment rather than lightly toned.
Every reference has its own detail frame and no frame stands in for two references. Any reference without one is named.
Every detail crop contains the whole of the thing it depicts. A crop is not delivered by being filled to the right shape.

The certificate run is one print ready file with exactly one card per register row, in register order, each card carrying its own serial, caliber and regulator initials and a picture of the piece that serial belongs to.
Every field that appears on last season's card appears on this season's cards. A card that is missing a line while the run reports success is the failure this bar exists to catch.

All four campaign canvases live in ONE working file, each keeping its own canvas size, delivered alongside the self contained source it was built from, with live text in one type system rather than a picture of a layout.

The note records, per frame, what was applied and why that frame differs from its neighbours, every resize any tool reported, the register reconciliation, and anything about the campaign that could not be delivered.

adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_initialize_file_upload and asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_inline_preview, image_auto_straighten, image_apply_adjustments (masked and unmasked), image_apply_monochromatic_tint (masked), image_add_grain, image_select_by_prompt with returnBbox, image_select_subject, image_invert_selection, image_fill_area, image_remove_background in both the transparent and the backgroundColor forms, image_crop_to_bounds, image_crop_and_resize reading metadata.tradeoffs, detection_confidence and upscale_factor
adobe_surfaces.role: Every raster decision in the commission. It sets one house target off the best lit frame and corrects nine campaign frames toward it one call at a time across two photographers and two polarizer states, confines the reflection work to the crystal by naming the material rather than the object, commits the single tone signature and its grain as one recipe across the set while carving out the true colour dial frame, produces both the store's white ground plates and the dealers' genuinely transparent variants, and drives the sparse detail crops from explicit selections where a subject focused crop cannot be trusted.

adobe_surfaces.surface: InDesign layout, merge template authoring, data merge and press render
adobe_surfaces.tools: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt (both as a readout and as a validator), prepare_indd_merge_template with params.mappingJson as a JSON string, document_merge_data_layout with recordRange and additionalImageFiles, document_render_layout at resolution 300 with createSeparateFiles
adobe_surfaces.role: The certificate run, which is the only genuine record per page job in the commission: twenty four serials, one card each, built by reverse engineering last season's printed card into a live merge template. It is also where the agent produced imaging is consumed rather than admired, because each card binds the picture of its own piece through the image column, so a cutout decided six steps earlier arrives here at press resolution on a coloured panel.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Express, HTML authoring to a native editable document
adobe_surfaces.tools: get_account_type, create_visual_design_express_skill, html_export_readiness_skill, asset_initialize_file_upload and asset_finalize_file_upload with media_type text/html, export_html_to_express({url}), asset_search on CCAsset, asset_get_presigned_urls, asset_inline_preview
adobe_surfaces.role: The campaign set as one native editable document carrying four roots at four canvas sizes, which is the only surface here that composes free form fixed canvas layout. Every photograph has to be pulled down and carried as embedded image data because a reference to a URL arrives as an empty grey box at full success, each root declares its own canvas because a global override collapses a mixed size set, family and weight are declared on every text element, and the payload travels as an uploaded file because inlined photography passes the inline threshold immediately.

adobe_surfaces.tools: font_recommend called once per typographic role, font_styles, find_fonts, get_fontkit_embed_url
adobe_surfaces.role: The type system carried across all four campaign canvases and quoted in the handover. The recommender refuses to pair by design, so the pairing is the agent's own art direction and has to land on collector confidence rather than on luxury cliche. Numeric weights are non standard per family and cannot be inferred from a style name, a display cut is reached by its own slug rather than by weight, and every name must be laundered into canonical form before the kit call because one bad name discards the whole kit.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Stock and Adobe Boards, counted as ONE surface

adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the one frame the house does not have, a wrist and cuff lifestyle capture, IP clean, at genuine camera scale, with generative technology candidates excluded. The Boards half persists the selects the founder and the watchmaker sign off from, placed within the per call cap, with a partial result read as partial rather than as success.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable lands on which surface before touching a frame.
trajectory.judgement: The store tiles and the campaign masters are raster work against a hard spec, the certificate run is genuine record per page variable data, and the campaign set has to be an authored fixed canvas document because the client will change the featured reference themselves. The brief pins each destination, so there is nothing here to stall on.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming a surface per deliverable, plus the confirmed account tier that gates the export at the end.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset through initialize, PUT and finalize, holding each returned presigned URL against its role.
trajectory.judgement: Ordinary handoff discipline, but it has to be keyed by role rather than by filename, because the register, the detail frames and the product frames all refer to the same five references under different names.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role and reference.

trajectory.action: Preview all twenty photographs and triage them: which session each campaign frame belongs to, which were shot polarized, where the light on the sapphire covers the dial, which product frames are bracelet and which are strap, and which reference each detail frame actually shows.
trajectory.judgement: The client asserts five references with a detail frame each and twenty four pieces to certificate. Only the pictures can settle whether that is true, and reading the detail frames against the reference list is slower than counting files and is not the same thing.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note covering session, polarizer state, where glare sits, bracelet versus strap, and detail frame identity.

trajectory.action: Level what is off level, before any crop decision is locked.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes the subject and consumes edge pixels, so it cannot follow a crop that was chosen against the unlevelled frame.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed, originals untouched elsewhere.

trajectory.action: Fix one house target off the best lit frame and correct each of the nine campaign frames toward it with its own call, in colour, before any tint is committed, recording every parameter applied.
trajectory.judgement: The destination is a set, not nine good photographs. One batched call applies one identical parameter set, which is exactly wrong for two photographers and two polarizer states. Grading before tinting matters because a single tone treatment applied over frames that disagree hides the disagreement without removing it.
trajectory.produces: Nine graded colour masters at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Attempt the reflection work on the frames where the light on the sapphire lies over the dial: select the crystal by its own material properties rather than by the object it belongs to, confine the correction to that selection, and look at each result.
trajectory.judgement: Prompt wording is the entire gate, because naming the watch pulls the selection to the whole case. The correction has to be confined, since a whole frame move to hold the dial takes the steel flat.
trajectory.produces: Reflection worked frames, plus a read on each of what the correction actually moved.

trajectory.action: Commit the signature: one tint hue and one strength across the whole campaign set, then grain, judged as a row rather than frame by frame, and hold the true colour dial finish frame out of the treatment entirely.
trajectory.judgement: This is the irreversible craft decision in the commission. A tint hue chosen against a single hero will not survive contact with the flat lay on stone, and grain strength that reads as film at full size reads as noise at story scale. Carving out the true colour frame is an accuracy decision the client stated and the treatment must not soften it.
trajectory.produces: The signature campaign set at source scale, plus the untreated true colour frame, with the recipe recorded once rather than nine times.

trajectory.action: Knock out the five product references twice: onto the store's white ground for the listing tiles, and to genuine transparency for the dealer panels. Read every returned tradeoff record rather than the success message.
trajectory.judgement: The tradeoff record is the only channel that reports what a tool did to a frame's dimensions and it carries no warning language. The bracelet references and the mirror polished reference will not behave like the strap references.
trajectory.produces: Five white ground plates and five transparent variants, each with its returned tradeoff record transcribed.

trajectory.action: Cut the square store tiles at the store's spec with the watch optically centred, and crop the detail frames to the detail strip ratio, reading the confidence and bounds each crop returns.
trajectory.judgement: Optical centring is not geometric centring on a watch with a crown on one side and a bracelet running off both. A confident looking crop on sparse macro art is not evidence, and the fallback route costs calls the cheap route does not.
trajectory.produces: Five store tiles at spec, five dealer variants, and the detail strip with confidence readings recorded per crop.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries for the wrist and cuff lifestyle frame, filter to photography, exclude generative technology results, then license and download at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Choose the frame whose existing light can be brought to the house target rather than the prettiest thumbnail, and remember the thumbnail is all that exists before licensing. Long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero, so neither is used.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP clean, camera scale wrist frame.

trajectory.action: Bring the licensed frame to the house target, run the committed signature on it, and set it beside the treated campaign set to judge whether it belongs there.
trajectory.judgement: A bought frame either joins the world the nine live in or announces itself. The only place that can be settled is beside them, at the size the canvases actually use.
trajectory.produces: A treated lifestyle frame judged against the set, and a decision recorded either way.

trajectory.action: Convert last season's certificate to a working document, export the interchange format, and inspect what the conversion actually exposed: how many text frames, how many graphic frames, and what the true story text is when the runs are reassembled.
trajectory.judgement: The printed card is not evidence of its own structure. What can be addressed, and at what granularity, is a property of the conversion and not of the design, so it has to be looked at before anything is promised.
trajectory.produces: A true frame inventory and the reconstructed story text, held as the basis for every offset.

trajectory.action: Build the field mapping against the reconstructed story text, run it through validation, prepare the merge template, then round trip the document again and confirm every expected placeholder is genuinely present.
trajectory.judgement: Validation and a success message report intent, not outcome. The only proof a placeholder landed is finding it in the round tripped document, which is a step the tools never ask for.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholder inventory has been confirmed rather than assumed.

trajectory.action: Merge the register to one print ready file, one card per row in register order, binding each row's picture of its own piece through the image column, then merge again to a working document and render signing proofs at print resolution, and read the proofs.
trajectory.judgement: The image column is the whole reason the cutouts exist, and a naive run places one static picture on every card. Proofs at print resolution are the first moment the cutouts are seen at their real size on the card's coloured panel.
trajectory.produces: A print ready certificate run at one card per row, plus per card proofs at print resolution.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, pull the family style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own, judged against a four to twelve thousand dollar collector rather than against a luxury stereotype. The weight cannot be inferred from the style name and a display cut is reached by its own slug.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry or designer, and the actual numeric weight recorded per role.

trajectory.action: Author one self contained document with four roots at four canvas sizes, carry every photograph as embedded image data, let each root declare its own canvas, declare family and weight on every text element, then upload the file and hold the returned URL.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a reference is not a photograph, an auto sized wrapper anchored from the right throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override is precisely what collapses a mixed size set. The design work is how much air a collector piece is given and how the single tone treatment holds against live type.
trajectory.produces: One export ready source document carrying the whole campaign set, retained as the durable half of the deliverable.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export, then verify through the two channels that exist: resolve the document's rendition and look at the first canvas, and audit the returned per canvas markup for the other three.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning of any kind, and the rendition only ever shows the first artboard. Looking at canvas one is not looking at the deliverable.
trajectory.produces: A native editable document, an inspected first canvas, and a markup audit covering the other three.

trajectory.action: Create the selects board, add the treated set, the store tiles and the licensed frame within the per call placement cap, re sending only the entries the response names as failed, then write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: A partial success is reported as a success, so the failed list is the only honest count. The note has to be specific enough that next season's freelancer does not repeat the archaeology.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether there is anything under the light on the sapphire to bring back at all. On four campaign frames the softbox specular is fully clipped across part of the dial, so a highlight recovery confined to a crystal selection returns a successful call whose result is, in the region that matters, identical to the input. The readout is that nothing moves: no error, no warning, no tradeoff entry, just a new file that looks like the old one. Which of the four are clipped through and which merely look bright is a property of each exposure and cannot be read off the frame by eye at preview scale.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the question is whether the pixels carry information and the only instrument that answers it is the correction itself. Nothing in the brief or the deliverable list says the glare is unrecoverable; the client asks for the dial to read, which is a goal, not a disclosure. The response is not the same call again but a different route: confine a darkening or a controlled tint to the crystal so the glare reads as deliberate sheen, or accept that this frame cannot carry the dial and re plan which reference the campaign leads with.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re examine each of the four frames after the correction rather than trusting the response, re route the ones that did not move onto a masked treatment that shapes the glare rather than recovering it, and re open the campaign frame selection where a reference has no frame in which its dial reads. The signature commitment in the next step then has to be judged against the revised set rather than the intended one.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign where the hero frames of two references still have an unreadable dial, shipped as though corrected, on a line whose entire argument is a hand finished dial.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the transparent variants are transparent where the watch is not. Three references sit on bracelets whose link gaps are fully enclosed by the case and the folded clasp, and a one call knockout cannot punch an enclosed interior: it returns an alpha in which every gap is filled with captured sweep. On the white store ground that is pale grey on white and invisible at any scale. It becomes visible only when the cutouts land on a coloured panel at print resolution on the certificate proofs, where every link gap reads as a pale blob inside the bracelet.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it because the defect is created by the only cheap route to a cutout and is concealed by the very ground the store requires, so a competent agent inspecting the store tiles sees a correct result. Nothing in the brief describes the bracelets or the gaps, and the dealer panel colours sit in a notes file as brand information rather than as a warning. The response is a different chain entirely, selecting the sweep by its own material properties, inverting, and filling or cropping from that, which is three calls per reference instead of one.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re derive the transparent variants for the bracelet references through the material selection route, re check the result against a coloured ground rather than against white, re bind the corrected pictures into the certificate run and re render the proofs, and re read the store tiles to confirm the white ground versions were not quietly rebuilt with a different edge.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Two dealers publishing product panels in which every watch on a bracelet has grey rectangles inside the bracelet, and twenty four certificates printed with the same defect at press resolution, all of which passed inspection on white.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed wrist frame survives the signature treatment. Search returns a small thumbnail and nothing else, and the frame's real tonality only exists after the full resolution download. The specific risk in a single tone commission is that separation carried by hue collapses: a cuff and a skin tone, or a strap and a sleeve, that are plainly distinct in colour can sit at nearly the same value and become one undifferentiated mass once the tint is applied. Nothing in the search result, the thumbnail or the tint call reports this; the tinted file is returned successfully and reads as an intentional soft frame until it is set beside the treated campaign set.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: There is no ordering that reveals it earlier, because the information does not exist until the frame is licensed, downloaded and run through the committed recipe. Nothing states it: the brief asks only for a wrist shot the house does not have. The response is a decision rather than a re run, either license a different frame chosen for value separation rather than for colour, or introduce the separation before the tint with a confined darkening on one region, each of which changes what the campaign canvases can do with the frame.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re open the Stock selection against value separation rather than against subject appeal, or build a confined tonal separation into the frame before the tint and judge it again beside the set, then revisit which canvas the lifestyle frame carries, since a frame that only works small cannot lead the wide canvas.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign set whose one human frame reads as a grey smear beside nine crisp product frames, or worse, is quietly dropped, leaving the house with no lifestyle image at all after paying for one.

deliverables.name: Lunara autumn signature campaign masters
deliverables.spec: Nine campaign frames brought to one house target across two photographers and two polarizer states, then carried through one committed single tone treatment at one hue, one strength and one grain character, plus one licensed wrist frame graded and treated into the same world. Delivered with a recipe stated once and a per frame parameter log that says why each frame differs from its neighbours, and with any frame that could not be brought to the set named rather than shipped.

deliverables.name: Lunara store and dealer reference set
deliverables.spec: Five square store tiles at the store's tile size on a clean white ground with the watch optically centred and clear air at every edge, plus five dealer variants carrying genuine transparency everywhere the watch is not, including inside every enclosed gap in a bracelet, plus the one true colour dial finish frame held out of the treatment. Every output at or below its source pixel dimensions with the returned tradeoff record transcribed. One set with one cut logic, not one picture at several sizes.

deliverables.name: Lunara certificate run, twenty four serials
deliverables.spec: One print ready file carrying exactly one card per register row in register order, each card bound to its own serial, reference, caliber, case metal, dial finish, regulator initials and timing result, with a picture of the piece that serial belongs to placed through the image column rather than one static picture repeated. Every field present on last season's card present on every card. Delivered with per card signing proofs at print resolution and with the register reconciliation, including the duplicated serial and the reference with no usable frame, written up rather than silently resolved.

deliverables.name: Lunara autumn campaign set, four canvases, as one editable document plus its source
deliverables.spec: One native editable document carrying four roots at four canvas sizes, wide, square, portrait and tall, each keeping its own canvas, with live editable text in one licensed type system, every photograph carried as embedded image data rather than as a reference, and the signature treatment holding against live type on all four. Delivered with the self contained source it was authored from, which is the durable half, since the featured reference will move and the house cannot re commission.

deliverables.name: Handover note and selects board
deliverables.spec: A written note recording the signature recipe once and the per frame deviations from it, the type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the real numeric weight, every resize any tool reported against the frame it applied to, the register and detail frame reconciliation, and everything that could not be delivered and why. Paired with a persistent shareable selects board carrying the treated set, the store tiles and the licensed frame with nothing silently dropped.

verifiers_auto.text: Five store tiles exist, all square, all at the store's stated tile size, and no delivered file exceeds the pixel dimensions of the frame it derives from.
verifiers_auto.how: Read the pixel dimensions of every delivered file and compare each against the source frame named in the manifest.

decision_gates: Which deliverables are raster work, which is genuine record per page variable data, and which needs an authored fixed canvas document, given that only one surface here composes free form layout.
Whether nine frames from two photographers can become one set, and how far to push the two polarized frames before they stop being worth saving.
Grade first and tint after, versus tinting straight from the source, when a single tone treatment hides disagreement without removing it.
How to word the crystal selection so it takes the material rather than the object it belongs to, and whether to confine a correction or shape the glare deliberately.
The signature itself: which hue, what strength, how much grain, judged as one recipe against a collector band rather than against the most flattering hero.
Which frame is held out in true colour, and how visibly it is excluded, since accuracy and the signature are in direct tension on that one page.

Knockout route per reference: the one call route for a coherent strap piece versus a material named sweep selection inverted and filled for a bracelet with enclosed gaps and for a mirror polished case that carries the sweep in its flank.
Whether to trust a confident looking crop on sparse macro art or to spend the extra calls on an explicit selection.
How to report the register when a serial appears twice with different calibers and one reference has no usable picture, without quietly choosing for the client.
Whether the licensed wrist frame joins the treated world or is replaced, judged beside the set rather than at search time.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against a collector who reads a timing result before a headline.
How much air the four canvases carry, since at this band restraint is the design and a dense benefit led canvas is a correct looking wrong answer.
why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns handsome pictures of watches. IDENTITY: these are five specific references with their actual dials, hands, engraving and bracelet construction, and twenty four specific serials with a named regulator's initials and timing results; a regenerated watch is a different company's product and a regenerated certificate is a forgery of the house's own document. SPEC: the store needs square tiles at an exact size with air at every edge and no interpolated pixels, the dealers need genuine transparency inside a bracelet, and the certificate run needs exactly one page per register row in register order with the right picture on the right serial, none of which a generated image satisfies or can even be checked for. EDITABILITY: the campaign set is defined by being editable, because the featured reference will move and an eight person house cannot re commission four canvases every season. And the middle of this engagement is verification against material reality: did anything move under that glare, is this cutout transparent where the bracelet has holes, did every field actually land on the card.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account), five surfaces honestly counted, no banned capability and no dead surface. IMAGING: auto_straighten, apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, monochromatic tint and grain with maskURI, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, fill_area, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs, detection_confidence and upscale_factor, and remove_background in both the transparent and the backgroundColor forms are all verified headless across 27 live calls, with alpha confirmed to survive crops at png output. The three checkpoints rest on documented findings rather than on assumptions: remove_background CANNOT punch an enclosed interior and returns a solid opaque region while reporting success, which is exactly the bracelet gap case; a subject focused crop silently mis crops sparse art, observed at detection confidence 0.459 clipping 60 percent of the subject at full success; and Stock search returns only a 240 pixel thumbnail, so a frame's real tonality exists only after asset_license_and_download_stock, which was verified returning a genuine 7360x4912 file. The clipped specular checkpoint needs no new capability at all, only the fact that these tools report success without reporting effect, which the audit records repeatedly. INDESIGN: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt as readout and validator, prepare_indd_merge_template with mappingJson passed as a JSON string, document_merge_data_layout and document_render_layout are all verified fully headless and synchronous; one record per page for PDF output is verified with page count equal to row count in correct order; per row image binding through an at prefixed CSV column plus additionalImageFiles is verified visually; and 300 DPI raster is reachable only by merging to InDesign and rendering, which is why the trajectory does both. The lossy textContent readout, the collapse of a continuous flow into a single frame, and the validator reporting VALID on wrong offsets are all recorded live findings, which is why the acceptance bar scores placeholder presence in the round tripped document rather than the success message. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export are verified, the product is a genuine editable document findable by asset_search, photographs must be embedded because every external URL resolved to a placeholder, and the rendition preview is documented as first artboard only, which is why verification is split. FONTS: recommend, styles, find and kit is verified end to end. STOCK AND BOARDS: short queries only, orientation never passed, licensing verified, boards capped at twelve placements per call with 201 meaning partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no variable QR, no upscaling, no compositing, no OCR, no text to image, no generative fill, no fill_text, no animate_design, no replace_image, no photo reaching Express as a URL, no bleed gate on a PDF derived template, and no batch above 20.
